description: A 4x4 Junon grassland valley ringed by cliffs, rising gently from south to north. A lake fills the low south-west corner, with a rocky west bank and gentle shores elsewhere. A village of five houses sits on a broad hill north-east of the centre, overlooking the lake. Dense forest runs along the north edge and thins out toward the south. The north-west is rocky ground with boulders and few trees. The centre and east are open meadow. A farm lies in the south-east, where the player starts. A dirt road runs from the farm up the hill to the village, and a path continues west from the village down to a hut on the lake's north shore.
notes: Village of five houses: adventurer_village, lifted from Adventurer's Plain (five small houses plus one larger, crates and barrels).
Farm: breezy_farm; its path leaves through the archway (farmgate).
Hut: beach_hut, a single Sunshine Coast hut, on the lake's north shore.
'Thins out toward the south': the forest covers the north half, fading to 30% of its strength at its southern end.
Later cover areas override earlier ones: rocky north-west over the forest, meadows over the rest.
name: Mapgen Valley
